cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo full-length L1 in RB1 intron 14 (transmitted in the family) caused a highly heterogeneous RB1 splicing pattern, including aberrant transcripts using noncanonical acceptor splice sites; detected via mRNA studies.
cases.quote: Some of the aberrant mRNAs were produced by noncanonical acceptor splice sites, a new finding that up to date has not been described to occur upon LINE-1 retrotransposition.
